scope: finite-grid numerical two-time Dyson/KBE and self-consistent electron–boson Fock/SCBA control
implementation_change: Add explicit nonuniform-grid two-time convolution with matrix-order-preserving einsum.
Add numerical retarded/lesser Kadanoff–Baym Dyson fixed-point solver with initial lesser correlation term.
Add self-consistent Einstein electron–boson Fock/SCBA time-domain self-energy and Keldysh-consistent greater reconstruction.
claim_boundary: The solver is a finite-grid transparent fixed point, not yet a production-scale contour implementation.
Particle-number drift is reported and decreases by approximately four under time-grid refinement; no exact continuum conservation claim is made.
Continuum reservoir memory and interacting Kane–Mele/Corbino currents remain open gates.
